assets.prompt: Create a production-ready PHOTOREALISTIC explosion animation sprite sheet with a genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background, for a side-view miniature skatepark fighting game. Wide 2:1 image, preferably 2048x1024 pixels. EXACTLY 8 frames, arranged in an exact uniform grid of FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows. No captions, numbers, borders, separators, floor, scene, checkerboard, or background pixels. Each frame sits centered inside its own equal square cell with generous transparent margins so adjacent frames never touch. A single coherent realistic spherical pyrotechnic explosion photographed with a locked side camera evolves chronologically left-to-right across first row, then second row: 1 small bright white-amber ignition with tiny sparks; 2 compact orange fire burst; 3 expanding detailed incandescent orange fireball; 4 full energetic rolling fireball with charcoal smoke rim; 5 larger curling grey smoke with residual orange flames; 6 thinning turbulent grey smoke with a few embers; 7 faint curling smoke wisps and embers; 8 very sparse fading wisps and a few isolated embers. All eight explosion centers occupy precisely the same position within their cell. Real volumetric hot gas, finely resolved fire turbulence, convincing smoke translucency, crisp glowing embers, physically photographic practical effects. Bright orange and warm gold fire, neutral dark smoke, cinematic moody lighting. Keep the late smoke semi-transparent and the empty canvas fully transparent; do not bake a black or white rectangle around any frame. Nothing reaches a cell edge. This is a clean game-ready VFX flipbook atlas, not a concept sheet or UI mockup.

Create a production-ready PHOTOREALISTIC game prop sprite atlas on a genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background. Square image preferably 1536x1536, EXACTLY FOUR isolated assets in a uniform TWO columns by TWO rows grid. No words, labels, numbers, logos, borders, floor, cast shadows on a surface, checkerboard or background. Each asset must remain entirely inside its own equal square cell with at least 12% empty transparent margins. Match convincing miniature practical photography: worn dark metal, subtle machined highlights, moody realistic studio lighting, fine material texture, simple readable silhouettes at small game scale. TOP LEFT: one upright compact olive-green metal hand grenade with segmented egg-shaped body, dark steel top lever and clearly visible safety ring, front/side three-quarter view, photographed as a toy-sized prop. TOP RIGHT: one horizontal futuristic shoulder-fired rocket launcher, full left-facing stock to right-facing muzzle, dark olive and black weathered cylindrical metal tube, pistol grip underneath its middle, a subtle amber detail, side orthographic view, no real-world brand or writing. BOTTOM LEFT: one horizontal compact futuristic submachine gun, dark gunmetal body, short barrel pointing RIGHT, solid left stock, short magazine and pistol grip underneath, convincing miniature scale, true side view, no real-world brand or writing. BOTTOM RIGHT: a standalone realistic photographic muzzle-flash effect pointing RIGHT, concentrated white-hot origin toward the LEFT, orange-gold conical gas bloom extending RIGHT with a few crisp sparks and faint translucent smoke; no gun connected. The fire effect needs true soft alpha transparency, the three solid props need clean anti-aliased alpha edges. Fully transparent empty cells. This is a clean cutout atlas for a videogame, not a scene or illustration sheet.

inspection: Generated RGBA masters inspected visually and alpha histogram checked; no matte removal or vector substitutes. Native conversion only resizes/encodes retained RGBA.
